subject: Re: HealthWave – transfer orchestration & DPA sequencing for pilot
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Tom Evans <tom.evans@healthwave.com>, HealthWave Legal <legal@healthwave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T17:12:00Z
Subject: HealthWave pilot — transfer orchestration & DPA sequencing

Hi Tom / legal team,

Thanks for kicking off the pilot conversation earlier. To make sure we sequence the DPA signing, SCC mapping, and any UK IDTA/UK Addendum conversation properly, here are the concrete asks from our side so we can scope the TIA/DTIA workstream:

- Confirm the list of processing locations (primary customer locales + any outliers). We need to know if you expect any UK-only residency for pilot data.
- Provide HealthWave's current processor/subprocessor CSV (names, country, purpose). If you have an exported list we can map to our subprocessor roles.
- Let us know whether HealthWave will require the UK IDTA as a separate signature or if a single DPA + TIA mapping is fine for contractual purposes.
- Any special logging or retention requirements (e.g., 13 months for audit logs, or onshore cache retention windows).

Attached: a starter SCCs mapping worksheet and our standard DPA (redlines expected).

Proposed short next steps:
1) You confirm items above (by EOD Thurs 8/30)
2) We schedule a 30-min technical handoff (week of 9/6) with Kimberly and Laura to align on TIA scope and evidence timelines
3) We circulate a DPA + DocuSign link for signature once redlines are resolved

If you prefer, we can run the mapping on our side if you grant export access to the subprocessor list (or drop the CSV).

Thanks —
Rachel

On Thu, Aug 29, 2026 at 10:12 AM Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Tom / legal team,
> 
> Thanks for kicking off the pilot conversation earlier...

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers from our side:

- Primary processing will be in the EU (Ireland, Germany). We expect a small percentage (approx 3%) of API calls to route through US-hosted analytics services for spike processing; no UK-residency requirement for pilot.
- Attaching our current subprocessor export (CSV attached to this reply). If you prefer, procurement can share a formatted export.
- HealthWave legal prefers a signed UK Addendum where required, but for this pilot they are OK with a DPA + TIA mapping provided we document the fallback for UK regulators if asked. We will confirm officially with Legal by EOD tomorrow.
- Retention: we have a 12-month audit log retention mandate; no additional onshore cache SLAs for now — that said, we do need to ensure an onshore fallback plan exists (for later phases).

We reviewed your DPA redlines at a high level and marked a handful of points for legal to counter-propose (see attached comments in the PDF). We can do a short call if that helps.

Thanks — I pulled the sheet and started mapping. High-level notes for the package we'll send to HealthWave:

1) SCC/transfer mapping: completed for primary EU processors. For the US analytics hops (~3%) we map to our Standard SCC flow + contractual subprocessors that use encryption-in-transit and at-rest. 2) UK Addendum posture: since pilot does not require UK residency, propose: (a) sign DPA now with a TIA annex mapping (covers EU->US hops) and (b) pre-authorized UK Addendum template queued in DocuSign if HealthWave confirms UK regulator will insist.

3) Docs and artifacts to send in the consolidated package: sccs_mapping_healthwave.xlsx (completed), redwood_safeguards_summary.pdf (short control summary), proposed TIA paragraph (one-paragraph summary), link to our audit-log retention attestation, and DocuSign DPA link.

4) Timeline: we can turn the mapping + TIA paragraph by EOD 8/31. I will attach sccs_mapping_healthwave.xlsx and include the DocuSign prepare link in the email to HealthWave.

Action items I will complete now: populate spreadsheet, prepare the one-paragraph TIA summary, and collect SOC2 evidence + retention attestation.
